narrow-text: This paragraph wraps at 1280px in a 1920px column, leaving the rest empty. Let it use the width it has: remove `.wrap { max-width: calc(var(--maxw) + 2 * var(--gutter)) }`. If the design sets a measure on purpose, declare it at 40ch or wider: read the max-width from a --measure-* token, add data-ouro-measure to the text, or set "measure" in ouro-check.json.
